description: The shared sheet grabber. A drawer renders it as a slider; a modal or dialog renders it decorative so it stays out of the Tab order.

parameters.name: Decorative
parameters.description: Whether the handle is decorative. A decorative handle is not focusable and carries no label, because it is not a control.

parameters.name: SnapCount
parameters.description: How many snap points the sheet has. The slider's maximum is one less.

parameters.name: SnapIndex
parameters.description: The snap the sheet currently renders.

parameters.name: SnapIndexChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the keyboard moves the slider to another snap.

parameters.name: SnapValue
parameters.description: The fraction the sheet currently renders, spoken as the slider's value text.

parameters.name: OnDismiss
parameters.description: Raised when ArrowDown is pressed at the lowest snap, which dismisses the sheet.
